race.comment: SHANONI (10) was just fair fresh at Bendigo over 1300m but will improve quickly off that for the far more suitable rise in trip. This looks an open race but her form in Sydney last time in reads well for this and Damian Lane goes on. HOTEI SENSHI (2) just missed in a handy race fresh at Bendigo before tackling stronger 3yo company in town last time and running fairly. This suits better and with even luck from the gate he'll take beating. MISS TRUSTFUL (8) didn't do a bad job when fifth last start over 1700m at Geelong having won there prior. Drawn well and should give a sight again. TEL AVIV (7) is racing consistently, beaten under a length at Bendigo last time out. Will be up on speed and hard to catch.
